notes.title: Roadmap until the Steam release
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]Today I want to share with you the development roadmap for [b]Shattered Dreams: Redemption[/b] over the next few months, all the way to its release on Steam.[/p][p]I can officially announce that the [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3567910/Shattered_Dreams_Redemption/"]early access release on Steam[/url] is scheduled for January 28, 2026[/b].[/p][p][i](This date will not change unless a major issue arises, and if that happens, I will inform you in advance.)[/i][/p][p]Now, here is the roadmap, with each step listed in chronological order:[/p][list][*][p][b]Release of a new trailer before the October Steam Neo Fest[/b][/p][list][*][p]This will be the official trailer for the early access release of [i]Shattered Dreams: Redemption[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]October Steam Neo Fest – From October 13 to October 20[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Shattered Dreams: Redemption[/i] will participate in the October Neo Fest, where you’ll be able to try out the free SFW demo on Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]The demo will go live a few days before the Neo Fest begins and will remain available for one month.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Steam build preparation[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam release (version 0.6) on January 28, 2026[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Release of Version 0.7 after the Steam release[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ideally, it will come out in February.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]That’s the plan for the next few months — there’s a lot to prepare for the Steam launch.[/p][p]The Steam release is really important to me and to the game, and that’s why I keep repeating it: [/p][p][b]The best way to support the game is to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3567910/Shattered_Dreams_Redemption/"]wishlist it on Steam[/url] if you haven’t already, or to talk about it to your friends[/b].[/p][p]Whether it’s one or the other, don’t hesitate — those small actions help a lot![/p][p]That’s all for this post. Before I go, I want to thank you once again for all the support you give the game — you have no idea how much it means to me.[/p][p]With that said, see you next time ![/p]
